grader_mapping.title: Card heading text clipped at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The clipped text is the one-line card name held in an overflow-hidden box ('Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries', scroll 327 vs client 184); same mechanism as the truncated tool names on phones.

grader_mapping.title: Header link unreachable by Tab in the loan-open state
grader_mapping.reason: Reported only in the loan-open state on /tool.html: the Tab walk never reaches the link because Tab cycles inside the loan-length listbox, which is the seeded keyboard trap. Fixing the trap is the fix.

grader_mapping.title: Session radios visually reversed against DOM and AT order
grader_mapping.reason: Reverse visual order of the pick-up sessions with the document running forward, arrow keys moving backwards and a screen reader hearing the opposite order: the seeded reversed layout.

grader_mapping.title: Chosen pick-up day not preselected as the basket session
grader_mapping.reason: Not one of the thirteen. Genuine: the member picks a date on the tool page, the basket repeats 'Pick up Saturday 17 October', yet demands the same date again from six reverse-ordered radios and errors if it is forgotten; extra work and a slip path on a phone.

grader_mapping.title: No-match search leaves the full list and announces nothing
grader_mapping.reason: Searching 'sewing machine' leaves the status region empty and all ten tools showing with no message; exactly the seeded no-results defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' sits outside every landmark
grader_mapping.reason: Minor but genuine accessibility defect with a concrete basis (ARIA snapshot places the button after main, before contentinfo): screen-reader members who move by landmark or read main to its end do not meet the page's primary action. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Item headings at the same level as their section heading
grader_mapping.reason: Card and basket item names are h2 under an h2 'Tools' section, so the heading list screen-reader members navigate by is flat and the items read as peers of 'Search' and 'Opening times'. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-theme badge green about 3.1:1 on the card surface
grader_mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 for the 16 px bold 'Available from' badge in the dark theme, below 4.5:1; the seeded dark-mode contrast defect (with the token divergence as its cause).

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length listbox captures Tab
grader_mapping.reason: Tab (and Shift+Tab) move to the next option forever with no exit but choosing; the seeded keyboard trap.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name omits the field label
grader_mapping.reason: A screen-reader member tabbing to the control hears only 'One week, button' with no field name; concrete (aria-labelledby is on the listbox, not the button). Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days without warning
grader_mapping.reason: All 21 days selectable and a closed Monday 12 October accepted by Reserve; the seeded closed-day defect.

grader_mapping.title: Closed-day refusal only at final confirm with no route back
grader_mapping.reason: The late 'The library is closed on Monday 12 October' refusal with no link back to the day is the second half of the seeded D06 description.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up before the tool's available-from date is never checked
grader_mapping.reason: Observed end to end (a tool available from Sat 17 reserved and confirmed for Sat 10 with no warning); a member would turn up for a tool that is not back yet. Not among the seeded defects.

grader_mapping.title: Per-tool pick-up day and basket session never reconciled
grader_mapping.reason: The confirm summary can state two collection dates for one reservation ('pick up Saturday 10 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 28 October'), so the member does not know when to collect. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no visible or disabled busy state
grader_mapping.reason: Same underlying problem as the seeded double submit: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible during the 1.5 s wait; a visible or disabled pending state is the fix D12 needs.

grader_mapping.title: A second Confirm press allocates a second reservation number
grader_mapping.reason: Second press while pending creates a second reservation and the done page lists 'FT-4471 and FT-4472'; exactly D12.

grader_mapping.title: Done page rebuilds the reservation number from session history with a hard-coded fallback
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete code behaviour: a second reservation for the same session shows both numbers but only the last tools, and an empty store shows a literal 'FT-4471', so a member can be shown numbers that are not for the tools listed or not theirs. A different problem from the double submit, which this fix would not cure.

grader_mapping.title: Ten-minute hold enforced with no warning or extension
grader_mapping.reason: The invisible ten-minute hold behind 'Items are held for you while you finish' is the seeded D10.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold gives 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and every retry fails
grader_mapping.reason: The misleading generic error after the hold lapses is the second half of the seeded D10 description.

grader_mapping.title: Search form shown above results but after them in tab order above 480 px
grader_mapping.reason: The seeded defect is the stylesheet reordering search relative to the results so keyboard focus runs against the visual order; this is that focus/visual mismatch stated for the wide layout (the detector's jump back to 'Search tools' is the same). Aligning DOM and visual order fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Results grid minimum column of 330 px overflows at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: minmax(330px, 1fr) against a 288 px content box, cards 42 px too wide; exactly the seeded D05.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line hide the distinguishing words
grader_mapping.reason: nowrap plus ellipsis on card names so the two 18 V drills become indistinguishable on phones; exactly D03.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar not offset; content and focused days under it
grader_mapping.reason: 72 px fixed bar with 8 px page padding and no scroll-padding, footer and focused day buttons covered; exactly D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' neither announced nor associated with the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: An error raised by a button press is a plain paragraph with no live region, and focus lands on a day button whose name says nothing about it, so a screen-reader member does not learn why Reserve did nothing. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tool limit stated on the find page is not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Observed: the intro promises up to three tools and a fourth is accepted and confirmed without a word; a member would reserve more than the desk allows and find out at collection. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and mobile validation reject common equivalent formats
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete regexes reject 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234' and '+44 7700 900123'; members who type their numbers naturally are blocked at the last step. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Card and basket item names are h2 at their section's level
grader_mapping.reason: Same flat heading structure as F-0032 (plus the unstyled 'h3' class on basket rows): screen-reader members navigating by heading lose which items belong to 'Tools'. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Done page repeats the first tool name in visually hidden text
grader_mapping.reason: Minor but concrete: screen-reader members hear the tool name twice straight after the tools list and may think two tools are listed. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Inline style attributes bypass the spacing tokens
grader_mapping.reason: Code hygiene; the values match the scale and nothing changes for members.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket with no lasting cue
grader_mapping.reason: A vanishing toast, the same button label and the basket link out of view, so a first-time member thinks they are done; exactly the seeded D07.

grader_mapping.title: Search field after the full tool list on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Search two screens down after all ten cards at 375 px is the seeded phone reorder.

grader_mapping.title: Results change above the viewport after tapping Search on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Direct consequence of the seeded reorder that puts search below the ten cards on phones; placing search above the list, the D01 fix, removes it.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky Reserve visible before the required calendar
grader_mapping.reason: On a phone the first viewport offers the primary button while its precondition is below the fold and nothing says a day is needed, so a first press yields an error; concrete and on the main path, though low severity. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' stays on screen after a day is chosen
grader_mapping.reason: A stale error directly under 'Pick-up day: Friday 16 October' contradicts the page state and is still in the accessibility tree. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Basket asks for a session after the day was already chosen
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine redundancy as F-0029: the member must choose the pick-up date a second time and gets an error if they do not. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Session list latest first and includes sessions before the chosen day
grader_mapping.reason: The reverse chronological order of the session radios is the seeded reversed layout; the remark about earlier sessions is secondary.

grader_mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: A stale basket count on the confirmation page suggests something is still pending or the reservation did not go through. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts a pick-up day when the library is closed
grader_mapping.reason: Monday 12 October chosen, added and carried into the basket with no warning; exactly D06.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation confirmed for a session before the tool is available
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine gap as F-0142: the pressure washer listed 'Available from Sat 17 Oct' confirmed for Saturday 10 October; the member would arrive for a tool that is not there. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm page shows two different collection dates after changing the session
grader_mapping.reason: Observed contradiction in the summary ('pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'); the member cannot tell when to collect. Same problem as F-0038, not D13, which is the session being dropped.

grader_mapping.title: Change on the confirm page clears the typed details
grader_mapping.reason: Observed: membership number, name and mobile are empty after Change > session > Continue; re-typing three fields on a phone is a real cost. Not the seeded D13 (the chosen session being dropped with nothing saying so), and keeping the form would not fix that.

grader_mapping.title: Search above the list on desktop but below all ten cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: The width-dependent reorder that hides search on phones is the seeded D01.

grader_mapping.title: Filter control is an unlabelled icon
grader_mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only button as the only way to the date and category filters; same problem.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
grader_mapping.reason: Wednesday 28 at the top, Saturday 10 at the bottom, accessibility tree earliest first; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length list does not close with Escape
grader_mapping.reason: D09 says 'Escape does nothing' as part of the loan-length trap; this is that half of it.

grader_mapping.title: Two availability badge styles with no explanation
grader_mapping.reason: The badge text already states the date, so the unexplained styling difference neither misleads nor blocks anyone; a presentation preference with no harm shown.

grader_mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
grader_mapping.reason: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time is the seeded invisible hold.

grader_mapping.title: Date filter's helper text contradicts what the filter does
grader_mapping.reason: Concrete: 'tools you could pick up on or after this day' reads as including tools that become available later, yet with 17 October set those are dropped; members who read it would doubt the result. 'The opposite' overstates it, but the ambiguity is real. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Session days marked only by a small dot on phones
grader_mapping.reason: On the device most members use, the only cue to which days they can collect is a dot explained in a sentence above, a weak signifier that leads straight into picking a closed day. The seeded D06 is the acceptance of closed days; making sessions recognisable would not by itself fix that, so this stands as its own problem.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions shown latest first, the reverse of the calendar
grader_mapping.reason: Visual order Wednesday 28 to Saturday 10 with accessible order the other way; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm give no acknowledgement while the next page loads
grader_mapping.reason: No pending state on Confirm (or Continue) during the wait is the seeded condition that produces the double submit; same underlying problem as F-0039.

grader_mapping.title: Open loan-length list hidden behind the fixed bar on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Content covered by the fixed Reserve bar because nothing keeps the page clear of it; the seeded D08.

grader_mapping.title: Remove has no undo or confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: Immediate removal from a one-item basket with cheap recovery is a normal pattern; the finding shows no slip risk, only a preference for undo.

grader_mapping.title: No way to change loan length or pick-up day once in the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Searched every basket and confirm state: the only control is Remove, so changing loan length means removing the tool and redoing the tool page, a common review-time need. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Lower-case or unhyphenated membership number reported as missing
grader_mapping.reason: 'Enter your membership number, like FT-01234' tells a member who did enter one that nothing was entered; a misleading recovery message. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed bar covers focused controls and the open list on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Focused Loan length button and the 'Two weeks' option behind the fixed bar at 375 px; D08.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky bar sits over calendar rows and overhangs the column
grader_mapping.reason: The bar over the calendar rows and instructions is the seeded uncleared fixed bar; the 80 px overhang at 1280 is cosmetic.

grader_mapping.title: Spec list split into two misaligned label columns
grader_mapping.reason: A 44 px alignment difference between two label groups is visual polish; it does not mislead or impede members.

grader_mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
grader_mapping.reason: Appeal and specificity; members choose by name and date, and no behaviour or information is affected.

grader_mapping.title: No brand layer on any surface
grader_mapping.reason: A matter of taste and brand; no usability effect on the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Restates the reversed session order; D11.

grader_mapping.title: Uneven 1 + 5 session layout at desktop
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The finding says only 'At 1280 the first session card spans the full width and the other five share a row, with labels wrapping to three lines': a wrapping shape, with no order, keyboard or screen-reader consequence, which is what D11 is. The review reports the order separately (F-0143, its declared duplicate of F-0028/F-0077/F-0092, and F-0125), and those map to D11. Fixing the shape (equal columns, three per row) leaves row-reverse and wrap-reverse in place, and removing the reversal leaves six cards wrapping at five per row as 5 + 1, so neither fix cures the other. A desktop-only shape with legible three-line labels and no stated effect on choosing a session, for members mostly on phones: polish, as both graders treated F-0147, F-0110 and F-0115.

grader_mapping.title: Card titles truncated on phones (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Both drill names render 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'; D03.

grader_mapping.title: Search below all cards on phones (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Restates the phone reorder; D01.

grader_mapping.title: Nav labels wrap to two lines on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Two-line nav labels remain readable and operable; cosmetic.

grader_mapping.title: Empty bands and half-used columns at wide widths
grader_mapping.reason: Desktop appeal and layout preference; no effect on completing the task.

grader_mapping.title: Masthead still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine stale-count problem as F-0064. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.reason: 346 px capture at 320 px with cards at the right edge; D05.

grader_mapping.title: Search field below all ten tool cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Search after the full list at 375 and 320 but under the intro at 768+; D01.

grader_mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in the dark theme; D04.

grader_mapping.reason: The two drills become indistinguishable at 375 and 320; D03.

grader_mapping.title: Native date input in locale format beside a native select
grader_mapping.reason: A native date field shows the browser's locale format and gives members their own picker, an accessible choice; the baseline nit is polish. A coherence preference, not a member problem.

grader_mapping.title: Session cards break into 1 + 5 at desktop, earliest last
grader_mapping.reason: The reversed wrapping and the earliest session coming last are the seeded reversed session layout.

grader_mapping.title: Done page has no focal confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: The H1 'Reservation confirmed' and the details table do confirm success; wanting more emphasis is a hierarchy preference. The 'Basket (1)' remark is F-0064's item.

grader_mapping.title: Identity is only the name

grader_mapping.title: Calendar lacks a month label and the toast lands on its header
grader_mapping.reason: The 21-day grid never leaves October, the readout gives the full date on selection, and the toast covers 'We' for a few seconds; polish rather than something members would act on wrongly.

grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar sits over the calendar rows at 768 px, exactly the seeded case D08 names, so the day's hit area abuts the bar's.

grader_mapping.reason: Same nowrap, overflow-hidden card name; letting it wrap, the D03 fix, removes the clip.

grader_mapping.title: Masthead link never reached in Tab walk (loan-open state)
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The review scopes this item to /tool.html in the 'loan-open' state and cites A11Y-25, the same criterion as F-0141: the link is 'tabbable in the DOM, but a complete Tab walk never reached it'. With the loan-length list open a Tab walk never reaches the header link only because Tab wraps among the options (D09: 'Tab moves to the next option and wraps around'), and the only fix for what the review describes is to let Tab leave the list, which is D09's fix. The sentence 'People who use a keyboard or switch cannot operate it' overstates a link that works in the default state and the severity is inflated, but the reported problem's underlying problem is the seeded trap, and several items may map to one defect.

grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions and find-page search: visual order differs from reading and focus order
grader_mapping.reason: The basket half is D11 exactly: sessions in date order in the DOM, shown in reverse, arrow keys and screen reader running opposite to the screen. The find-page half overlaps D01's focus-order clause; the finding gives most of its weight to the basket reversal, so it maps to D11.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length button named only by its value
grader_mapping.reason: A screen-reader user tabbing to the control hears only 'One week, collapsed, button' and cannot tell that it sets the loan length; the visible 'Loan length' heading is not part of the name. Not seeded; a genuine accessible-name problem for members using a screen reader.

grader_mapping.title: Session-day button names do not start with the visible '10 Open'
grader_mapping.reason: The name 'Saturday 10 October, open' contains both visible words (10, open) and is more informative than the visible text; a voice-control user can still say the visible digit. No member is hurt; a technical nit rather than a failure.

grader_mapping.title: Session-day dot vanishes in forced colours at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: At narrow widths the green dot is the only mark that a day is a session, and the forced-colours capture shows it gone while the instruction still says to look for a green dot, so high-contrast users cannot tell open days from closed ones. Distinct from D06 (closed days selectable).

grader_mapping.title: Card and basket item headings at the same level as the section heading
grader_mapping.reason: Tool titles as h2 siblings of the 'Tools' h2 still give a screen-reader user every tool in the heading list; the flat hierarchy does not impede any task. Best-practice nit without demonstrated harm.

grader_mapping.title: Reserve button and status outside any landmark
grader_mapping.reason: The button and status sit between main and contentinfo and are reached by Tab and by linear reading; only landmark-jump navigation skips them and the status is a live region. A best-practice gap with no demonstrated harm to members.

grader_mapping.title: Done page exposes the tool name twice to assistive technology
grader_mapping.reason: Hearing the tool name twice on the confirmation page is a minor redundancy with no effect on understanding or on completing the reservation.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts days when the library is closed
grader_mapping.reason: Any day can be chosen, Monday 12 October is confirmed as 'Pick-up day' without comment, and the basket asks for a session separately; the seeded closed-day defect.

grader_mapping.title: No-results search keeps the previous results and status
grader_mapping.reason: search() returns silently on zero matches so the grid and the status region keep their old content; exactly the seeded empty-search defect, with the same effect for the date and category filters.

grader_mapping.title: Results grid minmax(330px) overflows the 320 px viewport
grader_mapping.reason: The 330 px track minimum against a 288 px content box is the seeded 320 px overflow.

grader_mapping.title: Card names cut to one line, hiding the distinguishing tail
grader_mapping.reason: nowrap plus ellipsis on .card__name hides the 'two batteries' / 'one battery' tail at phone widths; the seeded truncation defect.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length listbox traps Tab while open
grader_mapping.reason: Tab moves between the options instead of leaving the widget and only Enter closes it; the seeded keyboard trap.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length listbox stays open on outside click or blur
grader_mapping.reason: A member who taps elsewhere is left with the open list covering the content below it and no way to dismiss it except choosing an option. Adjacent to D09 but about pointer dismissal; fixing it would not remove the keyboard trap, so it is a separate, minor but genuine problem.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length trigger does not open with ArrowDown or ArrowUp
grader_mapping.reason: Arrow-key opening is an APG convenience; the button still opens with Enter or Space, so no keyboard user is blocked. Claimed from code only, severity 1.

grader_mapping.title: No visible change during the 1.2 s and 1.5 s submit waits
grader_mapping.reason: Only aria-busy is set, with no style, label change or disabled state, so nothing visible says anything is happening while Confirm reservation runs; the no-feedback half of the seeded D12 (the basket Continue uses the same code pattern).

grader_mapping.title: Confirm can be submitted again during the wait, allocating two reservation numbers
grader_mapping.reason: No in-flight guard and the button is not disabled, so a second submit pushes a second reference (FT-4471 and FT-4472); the seeded double-submit defect.

grader_mapping.title: After the hold expires Continue always fails with 'Something went wrong. Try again.'
grader_mapping.reason: The lapsed-hold path shows the generic message and every retry fails the same way; the seeded hold-expiry defect.

grader_mapping.title: 10-minute basket hold never disclosed, warned about or extendable
grader_mapping.reason: The basket says only 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time shown; the seeded undisclosed-hold defect.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days chosen on the tool page, rejected only after Confirm
grader_mapping.reason: All 21 days are enabled, the closed-day check runs only in the confirm submit, and the error offers no way back to the calendar; the seeded closed-day defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' link drops the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: The Change link omits the slot parameter, so the basket returns with no session selected and the member must choose again; the seeded defect.

grader_mapping.title: Stated three-tool limit not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: The finder states a three-tool limit but reserve, basket and confirm never check the count, so a member can confirm more tools than allowed and be refused at the desk. Not seeded; a stated rule the system does not enforce.

grader_mapping.title: Phone and membership patterns reject valid formats
grader_mapping.reason: +44 numbers (which autocomplete=tel often supplies), hyphenated or differently spaced numbers and lowercase 'ft-' are rejected, so members with a valid number cannot complete the confirm form without guessing the expected format. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: CSS reordering: finder and session list focus order differs from visual order
grader_mapping.reason: The session-list half (row-reverse with wrap-reverse, arrow keys moving opposite to the screen) is D11 verbatim and matches its 2.4.3 criterion; the finder half overlaps D01's focus-order clause. One mapping is required, and the mechanism and criterion match D11.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode success token and tint wrong; badge about 3.1:1
grader_mapping.reason: --color-ok #2f7d4a on a tint equal to the surface #1d2622 gives about 3.1:1 for the 'Available from' badge; the seeded dark-theme contrast defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' toast gone after about 1.35 s with no link
grader_mapping.reason: The toast is the only feedback and disappears in about 1.3 s with no link and nothing persistent; the seeded weak-feedback defect on Reserve.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar covers the end of the page; no space reserved
grader_mapping.reason: position: fixed bar with .page--bar reducing bottom padding to 8 px, so the footer and the last calendar row sit under the bar; the seeded fixed-bar defect.

grader_mapping.title: Search field below the whole tool list on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: At 375 px search and the Filters button come after all ten cards, two-thirds down the page; the seeded phone-layout defect.

grader_mapping.title: Search results update above the viewport
grader_mapping.reason: Because the search box sits below the list on phones, the filtered results and the '2 tools found' status change out of view; a consequence of the same layout reordering as D01, which its fix removes.

grader_mapping.title: Day grid below the fold, heading under the sticky bar, commit button offered first
grader_mapping.reason: A fixed bar covers whatever lies at the fold until the member scrolls, and a required choice below the first viewport on a 375 px phone with an always-visible CTA is the ordinary mobile pattern; the finding does not show that pressing Reserve without a day fails. Speculative.

grader_mapping.title: After Reserve nothing persistent says the reservation is unfinished
grader_mapping.reason: Only the short toast, the button label unchanged, and 'Basket (1)' scrolled out of view at 375 px; the seeded defect.

grader_mapping.title: Basket asks for a pick-up session again with nothing preselected
grader_mapping.reason: The day chosen on the tool page is repeated on the basket card but not carried into the session list, so the member answers the same question twice and can pick a contradicting session. Not one of the seeded defects (D13 is the Change round trip).

grader_mapping.title: Sessions listed latest first
grader_mapping.reason: Wed 28 first and Sat 10 last, so the first Saturday shown is not this Saturday; the visual face of the seeded reversed session layout.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm give no acknowledgement
grader_mapping.reason: Screen unchanged for about a second after the tap with no pressed or busy state; the no-feedback half of the seeded D12.

grader_mapping.title: No-match search shows the full list and no message
grader_mapping.reason: 'sewing machine' leaves all ten tools on screen and the status empty; the seeded defect.

grader_mapping.title: Filters toggle is icon-only
grader_mapping.reason: The three-line icon button with no visible text is the only way to the date and category filters; named in D01's description.

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from' filter hint does not match its behaviour
grader_mapping.reason: The hint promises tools you could pick up on or after the entered day, but entering 12 October removes tools available from 14, 17, 21 and 24 October, so a member planning a later Saturday is wrongly shown fewer tools. Label and behaviour disagree; not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up dates before the tool is available are accepted
grader_mapping.reason: A tool available from 17 October can be reserved for 10 October and every session is offered, so a member can book a collection before the tool is back and find nothing to collect. Distinct from D06 (closed days).

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up day and pick-up session can contradict each other
grader_mapping.reason: The confirm page can show 'pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Pick-up session Wednesday 21 October', so the member does not know when to collect and the desk holds two dates. Not seeded; a genuine flow-consistency problem.

grader_mapping.title: Typed confirm details lost after Change
grader_mapping.reason: Using Change, choosing a session and continuing returns to an empty membership field, so the member must retype within the same reservation. Different data and cause from D13 (session not preselected).

grader_mapping.title: Remove is immediate with no undo
grader_mapping.reason: Immediate removal with an empty-basket message is the normal basket pattern; the member explicitly pressed Remove and recovery is a few taps. Undo is a preference, not a demonstrated harm.

grader_mapping.title: Error summary stays after the basket is emptied
grader_mapping.reason: After a failed Continue and then Remove, the page says the basket is empty while the 'There is a problem' alert still asks to choose a session and links to a list that no longer exists; a stale, misleading error. Minor but a real state bug.

grader_mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
grader_mapping.reason: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no duration; the seeded undisclosed-hold defect.

grader_mapping.title: Reserved tool stays in the basket after confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: After confirming, 'Basket (1)' and a basket still showing the drill with a Continue button suggest the tool is not yet reserved, inviting a second reservation or confusion at the desk. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Format errors read like empty-field errors
grader_mapping.reason: Both messages give the expected format ('like FT-01234', 'like 07700 900123'), which is an adequate suggestion for the typed value; distinguishing 'empty' from 'wrong format' is polish.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length list does not close with Escape
grader_mapping.reason: Escape leaves the list open; part of the seeded listbox trap ('Escape does nothing').

grader_mapping.title: Search and filter state not kept in the URL
grader_mapping.reason: Bookmarking or reloading a filtered list of ten tools is not a need of members reserving a tool; a nicety, severity 1.

grader_mapping.title: Change opens the basket with no session selected
grader_mapping.reason: Arriving from Change with Saturday 17 October chosen, no radio is checked; the seeded defect.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar-day focus hidden under the sticky Reserve bar
grader_mapping.reason: Tab reaches Friday 16 / Saturday 24 October but the fixed bar covers the focused button completely; the seeded fixed-bar focus defect.

grader_mapping.title: Every calendar day is a tab stop; over 20 presses to reach Reserve
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The review measures a concrete cost, not a preference: 'every one of the 21 day buttons is in the tab order: eight Tabs from Loan length only reach Friday 16 October, sixteen reach Saturday 24 October, and the Reserve button comes after all 21'. For keyboard and switch members that is over twenty presses on every tool page before the primary action, on the critical path of the flow. It fits none of the not-a-problem kinds (not wrong, not speculative, not taste), and no seeded defect covers it (D08 is the bar hiding focus, not the number of stops). Consistent with the agreed real-unseeded mappings of F-0029 and F-0031, moderate accessibility costs with a demonstrated effect, and unlike F-0143, where Enter and Space still work at no cost.

grader_mapping.title: Same placeholder wrench thumbnail on every card
grader_mapping.reason: Look and feel: the thumbnail carries no information, but the name, category and availability do; a matter of appeal, not a usability problem for reserving a tool.

grader_mapping.title: No identity beyond the name in the masthead
grader_mapping.reason: Brand and visual identity; a matter of taste, not a usability or accessibility problem.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar hides the open loan-length options at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The review's words are 'the fixed Reserve bar covers every option except One week' at 375 px on /tool.html, under A11Y-05, and its reply files this under one problem: 'The sticky Reserve this tool bar on phones hides what sits under it... It covers keyboard focus on calendar days and on the loan-length button, and covers the open loan-length options at 375 px.' That is D08's underlying problem on the same page: the bar 'is fixed to the bottom of the window and nothing keeps the page clear of it', so it covers interactive content, including the focused option as a member arrows down the list. Both graders already mapped F-0025 (the same control's focused button hidden behind the bar) and F-0097 to D08; the open list of that button is the same defect, not a new one. Which CSS fix the author would pick does not change the underlying problem.

grader_mapping.title: Added-to-basket toast drawn over calendar cells
grader_mapping.reason: A toast overlaying content for about a second is its normal behaviour; no harm shown.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names truncated at 375 px so the drills look identical
grader_mapping.reason: 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' for both drills; the seeded truncation defect.

grader_mapping.title: Native date and select controls, misaligned
grader_mapping.reason: Native pickers are usable (and often better on phones); a ~30 px label offset is visual polish, not a usability problem.

grader_mapping.title: Dark theme drops the available badge's pill
grader_mapping.reason: The missing tint is the seeded dark-mode badge problem seen from the design side: the tint equals the card surface, leaving green text on the card at about 3.1:1.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation number, session and deposit without emphasis on the done page
grader_mapping.reason: The values are present and labelled in the summary box; emphasis is hierarchy polish, not a usability problem.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions latest-first in an uneven one-plus-five layout at desktop
grader_mapping.reason: The backwards order and the stranded full-width card are the row-reverse / wrap-reverse layout seeded as D11.

grader_mapping.title: Two detail lists with misaligned value columns
grader_mapping.reason: A 44 px difference between value columns is visual polish; the details remain readable.

grader_mapping.title: Search below the whole tool list on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Search and the filter button after all ten cards at 375 px; the seeded defect.

grader_mapping.title: No visual identity beyond the name
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0111; brand taste, not usability.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation number shares the FT- prefix with membership numbers
grader_mapping.reason: Confusion between FT-4471 and FT-01234 is speculative; the two differ in length and are labelled where shown.

grader_mapping.title: Same wrench glyph on every card
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0110; appeal, not usability.

grader_mapping.title: No identity or focal point on any surface
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0111; taste.

grader_mapping.title: Titles truncate on phones so the two drills read identically
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded truncation.

grader_mapping.title: Search block below all ten cards on phones
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded phone layout.

grader_mapping.title: Unthemed browser-default date and select controls
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0114; polish.

grader_mapping.title: Two misaligned definition lists under Details
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0118; polish.

grader_mapping.title: Sessions in reverse date order with a stranded full-width card
grader_mapping.reason: The same reversed layout.

grader_mapping.title: Right half of the page empty at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: A ~610 px reading column on a wide screen is a normal measure; taste.

grader_mapping.title: Footer stops short, grey band below
grader_mapping.reason: Cosmetic on short pages at 1280 x 900; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: Done page still shows 'Basket (1)'
grader_mapping.reason: Same genuine problem as F-0080: after confirmation the header implies the tool is still unreserved in the basket.

grader_mapping.title: Available badges lose their tint in dark mode
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded dark-mode badge problem as F-0115 and F-0050.

grader_mapping.title: No-results search shows the full catalogue on phones
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded empty-search defect.

grader_mapping.title: 'Oct' wraps alone in badges at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: Typographic polish; 'Available from Sat 10 / Oct' is still readable.

grader_mapping.title: Navigation links wrap to two lines at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: The links remain legible and tappable; a taller masthead is polish.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm and done fill only half the width at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0148; taste.

grader_mapping.title: Reservation number is plain body text
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0146; polish.

grader_mapping.title: No-results state shows the full list with no empty-state message
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded defect, stated from the design side with a capture caveat.

grader_mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1, #2f7d4a on #1d2622
grader_mapping.reason: The seeded dark-theme badge contrast, found by axe.

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
grader_mapping.reason: The seeded dark-theme badge contrast, found by the contrast check.

grader_mapping.title: Weak by APCA, passes WCAG: 'Members can reserve up to three tools at'
grader_mapping.reason: Advisory only: passes WCAG at 8.33:1; no member is hurt by text at that contrast.

grader_mapping.title: Weak by APCA, passes WCAG: 'Category'
grader_mapping.reason: Advisory only: passes WCAG at 8.33:1.

grader_mapping.title: Weak by APCA, passes WCAG: 'Items are held for you while you finish.'
grader_mapping.reason: Advisory only: passes WCAG at 8.33:1.

grader_mapping.title: Weak by APCA, passes WCAG: 'Tools'
grader_mapping.reason: Advisory only: passes WCAG at 7.33:1.

grader_mapping.title: Weak by APCA, passes WCAG: 'Reservation number'
grader_mapping.reason: Advisory only: passes WCAG at 7.33:1.

grader_mapping.title: Day button and Reserve bar 0 px apart at 768 px
grader_mapping.reason: The zero gap is the fixed bar lying over the first calendar rows at 768 px, which D08 describes.

grader_mapping.title: Card h2 clips under the text-spacing override
grader_mapping.reason: The nowrap / overflow-hidden name truncation seeded as D03, surfaced by the 1.4.12 override.

grader_mapping.title: Card h2 clips at 200 % text size
grader_mapping.reason: The same one-line name truncation under zoom.

grader_mapping.title: #reserve overlaps day '17' at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: D08 names the third calendar row sitting under the bar at 1280 px.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow 346 px > 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The seeded 26 px sideways scroll at 320 px from the results list items.

grader_mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The same seeded overflow reported against 1.4.10.

grader_mapping.title: Card h2 clipped at 320 px (327 vs 184 px)
grader_mapping.reason: The same one-line name truncation at phone width.

grader_mapping.title: #reserve overlaps #tool-from under the spacing override at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The finding says only that 'At 320 px with the WCAG 1.4.12 spacing override, #reserve (Reserve this tool) overlaps #tool-from (Saturday 10 October)': a static detail line in the upper part of the tool page that happens to sit in the bottom 72 px of the first viewport once the override lengthens the page. A fixed bar always paints over whatever is at the fold, and the line scrolls into view, so nothing is lost under the override and no 1.4.12 failure is shown. D08's harm is different (the page ending 8 px under the calendar so the footer runs under the bar, and focused day buttons covered); D08's fix would not change this overlap and removing this overlap would not fix D08. Both graders agreed that F-0060, 'a fixed bar covers whatever lies at the fold until the member scrolls', is not-a-problem, and the same reasoning applies here. A checker artefact.

grader_mapping.title: #reserve overlaps #tool-blurb at 200 % text size
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The same artefact as F-0015 at 200 % text size: 'At 320 px with the root font size at 200 %, #reserve (Reserve this tool) overlaps #tool-blurb (A brushless combi drill with hammer action...)'. The blurb is the description paragraph near the top of the page; at 200 % it reaches the fold at scroll 0 and the fixed bar paints over its last lines until the member scrolls. No content or function is lost, so it is not a 1.4.4 failure, and it is neither D08's end-of-page coverage nor its focused-control coverage. Consistent with the agreed not-a-problem mapping of F-0060.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'You can collect at any of these sessions'
grader_mapping.reason: A typographic widow; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'Nothing is paid online...'
grader_mapping.reason: A typographic widow; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: Body text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The 330 px card overflowing a 320 px viewport pushes its text to the edge; the same cause as D05.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: tool heading at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: A typographic widow; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'Reservation confirmed'
grader_mapping.reason: A typographic widow; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: Cramped padding 6.4 px in the card body
grader_mapping.reason: A 2 px shortfall in card padding is polish.

grader_mapping.title: One word on the last line: 'Drills and drivers · deposit £20'
grader_mapping.reason: A typographic widow; no effect on members.

grader_mapping.title: Focus jumps back from the tile saw to 'Search tools'
grader_mapping.reason: Focus order running against the visual order on the finder is the focus clause of D01.

grader_mapping.title: Focused 'One week' hidden behind the action bar
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar covering a focused control; the seeded D08 mechanism, here on the loan-length button.

grader_mapping.title: Basket hold runs out without warning; Continue then says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and retrying (and the Change route) never recovers
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D10. The review says the hold 'starts when the first tool is added and lasts 10 minutes. The page never says so', and that once it lapses 'Continue shows only "Something went wrong. Try again."', which neither says what happened nor what to do. The never-reset timer and the 'Change' route dead end are consequences of the same lapsed-hold handling.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts impossible pick-up days (closed days, days before the tool is available); refused only at Confirm with no link back
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D06. 'The calendar lets you choose any day, including days the library is closed', the closed-day message 'only shows up after the member has typed in all their details and pressed Confirm', and it 'gives no link to where they can do that'. The days-before-availability point is a broader statement of the same unconstrained calendar; the review's fix (offer only open sessions on or after the available-from date) would fix D06.

grader_mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session can disagree, so the confirm page shows two different pick-up dates
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. No seeded defect covers the day-versus-session contradiction (D06 is the calendar, D13 the dropped session). The review quotes the confirm page showing '...pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October'; a member who trusts the summary can turn up on the wrong day and the desk can hold the tool for the wrong day.

grader_mapping.title: Two cordless drills truncated to the same name in the list on a phone
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D03. 'Tool names are cut to one line, so both show as "Cordless drill 18 V, co..."' at 375 px, and members 'can't see "two batteries" vs "one battery"'; letting names wrap fixes D03.

grader_mapping.title: Double-tapping Confirm creates two reservations (FT-4471 and FT-4472)
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D12. 'I tapped twice and the done page said "Reservation numbers FT-4471 and FT-4472"': Confirm stays enabled while the request runs and a second press allocates a second reservation number.

grader_mapping.title: Basket count and hold are not cleared after the reservation completes; header still shows 'Basket (1)'
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Not D12 (the duplicate reservation) or D10 (the lapsed-hold message): this is stale state after success. The review observed 'The header still shows "Basket (1)"' on the done page, 'which makes members wonder whether the booking went through', and the old hold stays so 'their next reservation runs straight into problem 1'.

grader_mapping.title: On phones the search box sits below all ten tool cards, and the date filter is hidden behind an unlabelled icon
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D01 (A as one item, B as two: its R7 and R9; merged here, see settled). 'On small screens the CSS moves the search box below all ten tool cards', so after a search 'the list changes off-screen above them and they see nothing happen', and 'The date filter is hidden behind an unlabelled icon'. That is D01 exactly: the page reordered so the list comes before the search form, and the date and category filter reachable only through an icon-only button, one discoverability failure. The review's fix ('Put search first' and 'give the filter button a visible "Filters" label') fixes D01.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old list in place and shows no message
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D02. 'A search with no matches (I tried "mower") leaves the old list in place with no message, even for screen readers': the status region stays empty and the member cannot tell whether the search ran or nothing matched.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge is hard to read (3.07:1, colour differs from DESIGN.md, no visible background)
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D04. 'The text contrast is 3.07:1; it needs 4.5:1 at 16 px', naming the same colour (#2f7d4a) and element as the seed. The DESIGN.md mismatch and the tint that 'is the same colour as the card' are parts of the same badge-legibility problem.

grader_mapping.title: Larger text and zoom cause sideways scrolling (330 px minimum card width; 7-column calendar)
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D05. 'At 320 px the find page is 346 px wide' and at 200% text 'the find and tool pages are 414 px wide on a 375 px screen', caused by 'the 330 px minimum card width'; the review's minmax(min(100%, 330px), 1fr) is the fix for D05. The calendar overflow is a second cause of the same reflow symptom and does not change the mapping.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions are listed in reverse; keyboard and screen-reader order runs opposite to the visual order
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D11. 'row-reverse plus wrap-reverse puts Wednesday 28 October at the top and the soonest session at the bottom', while 'Keyboard and screen-reader order still runs from 10 October, so arrow keys move the opposite way to what members see'.

grader_mapping.title: Coming back through 'Change' loses the session the member had chosen
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D13. 'Coming back through "Change" also loses the session they had chosen'; the review's fix (keep the current choice selected by passing slot in the Change link) fixes D13.

grader_mapping.title: The loan-length list traps the keyboard (Tab cycles the options, Escape does nothing)
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D09. 'Once it's open, Tab just cycles through the options, and Escape doesn't close it (both confirmed)', so a keyboard user can only leave the custom listbox by choosing an option.

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' disappears after about 1.3 s and does not say what to do next
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D07. The only confirmation of 'Reserve this tool' is a message that 'disappears after about 1.3 seconds' with nothing lasting nearby, so 'First-time members don't know there's a basket step'; a confirmation that stays put with a 'Go to basket' link fixes D07.

grader_mapping.title: Forms reject reasonable input: lower-case membership number 'ft-01234' and '+44 7700 900123'
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Not seeded. The review tested both values ('"ft-01234" (lower case) and "+44 7700 900123" both fail') and gives the code location; members who type their number in lower case or their phone in the ordinary +44 form are blocked by a validation error while a ten-minute hold runs.

grader_mapping.title: Continue (1.2 s) and Confirm (1.5 s) only set aria-busy, so sighted members see nothing happening and tap again
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D12. 'Continue (1.2 s) and Confirm (1.5 s) only set aria-busy, so sighted members see nothing happening and tap again' restates D12's mechanism ('nothing visible says that anything is happening'), which is what produces the second press. The Continue wait is a broader statement of the same silent-wait problem; the visible working state the review asks for, with the disabling it proposes in problem 4, addresses D12.

grader_mapping.title: The fixed action bar on the tool page covers the desk phone number in the footer
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: D08. 'the fixed action bar covers the desk phone number in the footer' is a narrower statement of D08 (nothing keeps the page clear of the fixed bar; on a phone the footer and desk phone number sit under it). The review's fix, bottom padding 'at least as tall as the bar (72 px)', is the clearance D08 lacks, though the review did not notice the covered focused day buttons.

grader_mapping.title: Done page: the hidden #c-tool makes screen readers read the tool name twice
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Not seeded. 'the hidden #c-tool makes screen readers read the tool name twice': a duplicated announcement on the confirmation page wastes screen-reader users' time and, on a page that can list more than one reservation, can suggest the tool was booked twice. Minor, and the review notes it did not verify with VoiceOver or TalkBack.

grader_mapping.title: Done page omits the return date and loan length
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Not seeded. 'The return date and loan length aren't shown, and those are what members will ask the desk about': the member chose a loan length earlier in the flow and the confirmation never says when the tool is due back, so they must remember it or ring the desk.

grader_mapping.title: The stated 'up to three tools' limit is not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Not seeded. 'The limit of "up to three tools" is stated but not enforced': the site states a rule it does not apply, so an over-limit reservation is discovered at the desk rather than prevented in the basket. Low severity but genuine.

grader_mapping.title: Going back through 'Change' from the confirm page loses the details already typed in
grader_mapping.reason: Both graders: real-unseeded. Distinct from D13, which is the dropped session choice, not the confirm form: 'Going back through "Change" from the confirm page loses the details already typed in', so the member retypes name, membership number and phone on a phone keyboard with the hold running; passing the slot in the Change link (the D13 fix) would not restore the typed details.

grader_mapping.title: Basket hold expires after 10 minutes with an unexplained 'Something went wrong' and no way to recover
grader_mapping.reason: Same problem as D10: the ten-minute hold is never shown on the basket page, and once it lapses Continue returns "Something went wrong. Try again.", which is not what happened and gives no way forward. The review's extra detail that retrying and reloading do not clear it matches D10's hold being kept only in the browser.

grader_mapping.title: Closed days are selectable in the calendar; refusal only arrives on the confirm page with no way back
grader_mapping.reason: Matches D06: every one of the 21 days can be tapped, the closed-day refusal ("The library is closed on Thursday 15 October... Choose another day") appears only after Confirm, and there is no link back to the calendar two pages earlier.

grader_mapping.title: A pick-up day before the tool's 'available from' date is accepted without warning
grader_mapping.reason: Not among the seeded defects: D06 is about closed library days, a different constraint, and disabling closed days would not stop this. The review reproduced it (pressure washer back 17 October, reserved for 10 October, accepted silently). A member would turn up for a tool that is still out on loan and the desk would hold an unfulfillable reservation.

grader_mapping.title: Tool-page pick-up day and basket session are collected separately and can contradict each other on the confirm page
grader_mapping.reason: No seeded defect covers two unreconciled date choices; D13 only covers the dropped selection on Change, and carrying the session through Change would not stop a member picking a different session in the basket. The review showed the confirm page reading "pick up Thursday 15 October" beside "Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October", so the member and the desk get two different dates for one reservation.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change' link reopens the basket with no session selected
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D13: tapping Change returns to the basket without carrying the chosen session, so the member has to choose again, and nothing says the choice was dropped.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm stays enabled with no visible busy state during the 1.5 s request; a double tap creates two reservations
grader_mapping.reason: Matches D12 exactly: nothing visible changes while the request runs (only aria-busy), and a second press produced two reservation numbers (FT-4471 and FT-4472). The aside that the basket's Continue has the same unseen 1.2 s wait is the same missing-busy-state problem on the previous page of the flow, not a separate defect.

grader_mapping.title: Truncated tool names make the two drills indistinguishable at phone width
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D03: one-line nowrap plus ellipsis in the card makes both drills read "Cordless drill 18 V, co..." at 375 px, hiding the "two batteries" / "one battery" difference the critical journey depends on.

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from' badge fails contrast in dark mode
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D04: --color-ok #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in the dark theme, about 3.1:1 against the 4.5:1 required; the review even cites the DESIGN.md value #8fd1a8 as the fix.

grader_mapping.title: Page scrolls sideways at 320 px because the results grid has a 330 px minimum column
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D05: minmax(330px, 1fr) forces the grid wider than a 320 px viewport (page 347 px wide), so the page scrolls horizontally (WCAG 1.4.10).

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length custom listbox traps keyboard focus (Tab cycles between options, Escape does nothing)
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D09: inside the open listbox Tab wraps between "One week" and "Two weeks" and Escape does not close it, so a keyboard user can only leave by choosing an option with Enter; the review's accidental change to two weeks illustrates exactly that.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name is only the current value ('One week'), with no 'Loan length'
grader_mapping.reason: A different problem from the keyboard trap and not one of the seeded defects. A screen-reader member who reaches the control hears only "One week" and is not told that it sets the loan length, so they cannot tell what the control is for before operating it (WCAG 4.1.2 / 2.4.6).

grader_mapping.title: Session list rendered in reverse order on screen compared with DOM, focus and screen-reader order
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D11: .sessions uses row-reverse plus wrap-reverse, so 28 October sits at the top while arrow keys and screen readers proceed in date order, the opposite way (WCAG 1.3.2 / 2.4.3).

grader_mapping.title: Fixed bottom bar covers the footer and desk phone number and can obscure focused calendar days
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D08: nothing keeps the page clear of the fixed 72 px bar (.page--bar leaves only 8 px bottom padding), so on a phone the footer and desk phone number sit under it and tabbed day buttons can be covered (WCAG 2.4.11).

grader_mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' message vanishes after about 1.3 s and has no link to the basket
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D07: pressing Reserve shows only a short-lived message, and the lasting sign is the "Basket (1)" count in the header that the member has to spot; a member who looked away cannot tell the press worked.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the old results on screen with a stale status
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D02: searching "strimmer" left the previous two drills on screen and gave no no-results message. The review reports the status region still saying "2 tools found" where D02 says it stays empty; either way the member cannot tell whether the search ran or what matched.

grader_mapping.title: At phone width the search box sits below all ten tools and the date filter is behind an unlabelled icon button
grader_mapping.reason: Same as D01: the order swaps under 480 px push the search form about 2,100 px down below the list, and the 'Available from' date filter is only reachable through an icon-only button, so members are unlikely to discover filtering by day.

grader_mapping.title: Details form rejects common ways of typing the membership number and phone number
grader_mapping.reason: Not a seeded defect. The review tried ft-01234, FT 01234, 07700 900 123 and +44 7700 900123 and all were refused. Members typing on a phone routinely use spaces, lower case or +44 (and autofill inserts them), so many would be stopped at the last form without being told what format is expected.

grader_mapping.title: Done page still shows 'Basket (1)' and the old item persists into a second reservation
grader_mapping.reason: Not a seeded defect. After confirmation the header still reports an item in the basket, so a member can believe the reservation is unfinished and go round again, and the review found that reserving again in the same visit brings the old reservation numbers back, which risks duplicate bookings at the desk.

grader_mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first.' error is not associated with the calendar or announced; focus jumps to a day button
grader_mapping.reason: Not a seeded defect. The error text is neither tied to the calendar (aria-describedby) nor in a live region, and focus is moved to the 9 October button, so a screen-reader member who presses Reserve without choosing a day is moved somewhere else without being told why (WCAG 3.3.1 / 4.1.3).

grader_mapping.title: Open-day marker on phones is only an 8 px green dot (colour and shape alone)
grader_mapping.reason: Not a seeded defect. The review's words are about the marker, not about choosing closed days: "The tool-page hint says 'a green dot on a small screen'. That relies on colour and shape alone, and the dot is only 8 px." Fixing that, which is the review's first remedy ("Showing 'Open' under the date at every size"), would leave D06 intact: closed days still selectable, refused on the confirm page, no way back. On a phone the only sign that a day is open is an 8 px coloured dot, so older, low-vision and colour-blind members cannot reliably tell open days from closed ones (WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color).
